speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; have these symptoms been gradually worsening over time, or did they appear suddenly? Do you experience any confusion, difficulty with daily tasks like dressing or cooking, or changes in your personality?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; given the progressive nature of the tremor and memory decline, have you noticed any changes in his handwriting, balance, or sleep patterns? I will also need to see his current medication list and arrange a brain MRI to check for structural abnormalities.
